highest_impact_findings: Evernorth's SEC prospectus directly selects Coinbase as principal market for XRP financial reporting, based on trading volume/activity, price consistency and regulatory/compliance considerations.

The filing reports $30M of convertible notes issued October 12; proceeds were intended for general purposes including XRP but actual XRP purchases from those proceeds are not verified.
The Cantor ELOC is optional, not cash on hand; no draw is verified. The filing has an internal $76.8M versus $80.7M gross-proceeds discrepancy.
BitGo is primary custodian; the prospectus says 100% cold storage as of its date, with multisignature/HSM controls and $250M shared insurance equal to 36.9% of the value of holdings as of October 9.

The prospectus says yield strategies and DeFi participation commenced following Closing, but does not disclose protocol, amount, wallet or counterparty. This needs reconciliation with the 100% cold-storage statement.
SBI Holdings is identified as a strategic investor; Ripple contributed 126.79M XRP to Pathfinder. Keep both distinct from the regional SBIC entities.
